title: Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing the appointment of Charles C. Duncan, Ph.D. as a new director to its Board of Directors, expanding the board from six to seven members. Dr. Duncan received an initial RSU award valued at $390,000, an annual $50,000 fee, and will be eligible for annual $260,000 RSU grants.
key_points: Vanda Pharmaceuticals Board expanded from six to seven members effective April 22, 2026
Charles C. Duncan, Ph.D. appointed as Class II director with term expiring at 2026 annual meeting
Dr. Duncan granted initial RSU with fixed grant date value of $390,000, vesting in four equal annual installments
Annual board fee for Dr. Duncan is $50,000, payable quarterly
Dr. Duncan eligible for additional annual RSU award valued at $260,000 after each annual stockholders meeting
Board determined Dr. Duncan is independent per SEC and Nasdaq rules
